product.name: Mars Express HRSC high-altitude global colour mosaic v1.0 (Michael et al. 2025, Icarus 425, 116350); data doi:10.17169/refubium-40624
product.files: pipeline/hrsc_sources.json: 4 filters x 6 faces, SHA-256 pinned
product.licence: Credit for HRSC data: ESA/DLR/FU Berlin (CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO)
product.quantity: reflectance per filter from a global colour model of relative colour within images, each filter calibrated to one observation area (Michael et al. 2025)
product.chosen: owner: 2026-09-29 a long-term average; 2026-10-02 'C. Guided blend': OMEGA's light and dark, HRSC's edges and colour (docs/stories/SS-14.md)
product.shading: images used with the illumination as acquired: some shading remains in the brightness, most on steep walls; the colour ratios cancel most of it

omega.name: Mars Express OMEGA 1.08 um Lambert albedo R1080, Ody et al. (2012), ESA PSA MEX-M-OMEGA-5-DDR-GLOBAL-MAPS-V1.0
omega.quantity: I/F / cos(i) at 1.08 um, assuming a Lambertian surface; each sample the average of observations from 2004-01-08 to 2010-08-20 (label)

gapFill.source: MGS TES bolometric albedo, Christensen; PDS MGS-M-TES-SPECIAL-V1 global_albedo_8ppd
gapFill.method: TES x (OMEGA / TES) averaged over the surrounding 41 x 41 TES cells (5.1 deg) that OMEGA measured completely

check.method: 1% of the TES cells OMEGA measured completely, chosen with seed 14, removed from the ratio and predicted

blend.method: guided filter (He, Sun and Tang 2013, IEEE TPAMI 35, 1397): guide HRSC 970 nm, target OMEGA 1.08 um with TES's fill
blend.otherBands: each HRSC band times blended(970) / HRSC(970): HRSC's own ratios to 970 nm, so the contrast falls toward blue as HRSC measured it

checks.instrument: OMEGA 1.08 um Lambert albedo (SS-14 W3 part 1)

conventions.projection: equirectangular (simple cylindrical), sphere R = 3396.0 km (the source faces')
conventions.longitude: east-positive; column 0 = -180 deg, last column ends at +180 deg
conventions.assembly: each pixel from the face whose centre is nearest, after an area-average warp of every face

texture.values: reflectance at 530 nm: HRSC 530 nm x blended(970) / HRSC(970), stored as byte = 255 sqrt(R / 1.2)

source.values: 0 where the large-scale level came from OMEGA, else the share of the pixel's anchor filled from TES, 1-255

colour.channels: red = R(750)/R(530), green = R(440)/R(530), blue = R(970)/R(530), each byte linear over its range; HRSC's own ratios, unchanged by the blend

format.decision: owner, 2026-10-02: 'Lossless, 6.25 MB', after lossy WebP smeared Valles Marineris even at q95 (docs/stories/ss14-encoding-valles.png)
